items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Barnett was saying the other day, that's the best. There's nobody as good.

ctx.x: He -- Clark can play any way that you like for him to play. He even played like Louis Armstrong, on -- four or five numbers, and just knocked Basie out. Basie didn't know he could do it like that. But he did. And he was just a versatile guy. He's a good trumpet player, he really is.
Barnett was saying the other day, that's the best. There's nobody as good.
He was a good trumpet player. And as far as playing bop and all that, he played bop better than any of the best of them.
